atRules.media: one (min-width:Npx) or (max-width:Npx), N integer240..8192; nesting up to4; no other media features initially

properties.color: typed color or matching known color var, text alpha>=0.5
properties.background-color: typed color or matching known color var
properties.border-color: 1..4 typed colors or matching known color vars
properties.border-radius: 1..4 nonnegative pixel lengths <=80, or matching known length var
properties.border-width: 1..4 nonnegative pixel lengths <=8, or matching known length var within property bound
properties.padding: 1..4 pixel lengths0..64, or matching known length var within property bound
properties.margin: 1..4 pixel lengths0..64, no negative/auto, or matching known length var within bound
properties.gap: 1..2 pixel lengths0..64 or matching known length var within property bound
properties.font-family: one approved font string Segoe UI/Segoe UI Variable/Arial/Tahoma/Verdana or --vl-font; canonical output ALWAYS appends trusted CJK/Cyrillic fallback stack
properties.font-size: pixels10..32; renderer multiplies by personal accessibility scale, cannot reset preference
properties.opacity: ONLY .vl-decoration; number0..1, never inherited by functional content/focus/canvas
properties.box-shadow: none or <=2 shadows; x/y0..24px, blur0..64px, spread0..16px, typed color; no inset initially
properties.backdrop-filter: none or single blur(0..40px), matching --vl-blur allowed
properties.filter: ONLY .vl-decoration; none or one drop-shadow(x y [blur] color); x/y0..24px, blur0..64px, exactly2offsets, no spread/inset
properties.transform: ONLY .vl-decoration; none or one scale(0.85..1.15); decorative layer clips within component; no arbitrary matrices/translations/rotation
properties.background-image: none, one url(canonical existing raster asset), or linear-gradient(0..360deg, two typed colors); no chained functions
properties.background-position: one center/top/bottom/left/right OR exactly two keywords: horizontal(left/center/right) then vertical(top/center/bottom)

variables: Only reviewed --vl-* references matching property family and bounds; no fallbacks/definitions/custom properties. Resolve to validated canonical literal using current effective tokens. Revalidate/recompile atomically on EACH appearance change/theme switch/entitlement change; keep last valid preview if an edit makes CSS invalid.
urls: Exactly canonical existing assets/... raster member, no preview.webp URL from user CSS; normalized rewritten vlui://SHA256/assets/... for client, internally owned blobs for isolated browser preview.
geometryAuthority: width/height/position/order/grid/flex dimension declarations are rejected; layout.json owns component dimensions/minima. Padding/gap/margin only bounded appearance; trusted box-sizing, viewport clamping, form reflow and internal canvas pan remain. Functional content cannot receive transform/filter/opacity.
editorBehavior: Autocomplete/diagnostics expose only supported subset. Errors identify unsupported declaration and retain last valid preview; no partial CSS application.
output: Only canonical serialized validated AST rules, never raw source; browser CSS preview isolated allow-scripts-only iframe; CSS does not style trusted native controls or builder UI
entitlement: Python checks current valid Premium before apply and after asynchronous completion; kept in original package while disabled for Free

astGrammar.selector: One []attribute block with ident data-vl-component, literal=, quoted string of known ID; optional ONE whitespace-descendant .class from allowlist; optional ONE final state :hover/:focus/:focus-visible/:disabled OR .is-selected/.is-active attached to the selected element. No other tokens/combinators. Comma-separated up to8 nonempty selectors. Reconstruct using canonical literal IDs/classes/state.
astGrammar.selectorEscapes: Parser-decoded escaped identifiers/strings accepted only if resulting EXACT identifier/string belongs to grammar. Canonical serialization removes escapes; no raw selector passthrough.
astGrammar.declarations: Parse declaration list; canonical ASCII lowercase property names. Duplicate canonical properties within one rule reject, including escaped/case aliases. Same selector in separate rules follows source order. Any important flag rejects.
astGrammar.values: Whitespace/comments ignored after accounting. Every remaining AST token is consumed by property's explicit grammar; parse errors/unknown/recovery nodes reject at any depth. Reject empty values and trailing unconsumed tokens.
astGrammar.variables: var(ONE ident --vl-known), no comma/fallback; permitted only as a typed leaf where color/length/number/angle/font expected, including corresponding shadow/blur/gradient arguments. Evaluate family and property's effective bound, substitute literal before output. Enums/URLs cannot use vars.
astGrammar.color: Hash6/8hex OR rgba(three ASCIIinteger channels0..255, alpha0..1 <=6fraction digits); exactly four comma-separated args, no percentages/currentColor/otherfunctions. color property alpha>=0.5; other color contexts0..1.
astGrammar.length: one px dimension with finite numericvalue in property bound; no unitless0, exponent syntax, percentages/calc; authored decimal <=3fractiondigits. Canonical zero emits0px.
astGrammar.number: one finite number in property bound; authored decimal <=6fractiondigits, no exponent syntax; canonical negative zero0. Number enums use mathematical integer semantics.
astGrammar.angle: one deg dimension0..360, decimal<=3fractiondigits; no other units
astGrammar.font: one quoted approved-font string OR var(--vl-font); output chosen font plus trusted fallback stack. No arbitrary font lists or external font source
astGrammar.boxShadow: none OR one/two comma-separated groups of x y blur spread color, exactly four boundedpx leaves plus color; no inset. CSS var allowed as correctly typed leaf.
astGrammar.dropShadow: none OR drop-shadow(two boundedpx offsets, optional boundedpx blur, color); NOspread/inset, color required
astGrammar.blur: none OR blur(one boundedpx leaf); var allowed inside blur as length leaf; decoration requirement applies to filter but backdrop-filter affects surface behind content
astGrammar.scale: none OR scale(one boundednumeric leaf); only .vl-decoration, clips to component, functional/canvas coordinates unchanged
astGrammar.gradient: linear-gradient(one degree leaf, color leaf, color leaf), exactly threecomma-separated args; no extra stops/positions or nested gradients
astGrammar.URL: one URLtoken OR url(ONE quoted string), parser-decodedcanonical existing assets raster name <=240ASCIIchars; canonical URLrewrite is internally supplied by trusted runtime, never supplied origin/network/raw source
astGrammar.media: only @media, ASCIIcase canonicalized; prelude exactly ONE ()block containing min-width or max-width ident, colon, finite mathematically integral pxdimension240..8192. Qualified rules and nestedmedia only in body. No and/or/not/range/otherfeatures.
astGrammar.counting: Maximum256 rules = all qualified and @media rules, includingnested. Maximum2048 declarations acrossallrules. Maxmedia nesting4. Token budget16384 =1per literal/ident/number/dimension/hash/string/URL/function/block recursively includingchildren; contiguous whitespace/comments do notcount. Rule/declaration counts separate from tokens. Parser-specific ASTwrapper nodes do notcount.
astGrammar.depth: Before ASTparse, bounded lexical scan ignores quoted/escaped string and comments while checking delimiter nesting<=8 and valid balancing; this is resource preflight, not semantic sanitizer. Value function nesting<=2; media nesting<=4. UTF8source<=64KiB before parse. Same deadline/cancellation across parse, traversal and serialization.
astGrammar.serialization: Drop comments. Emit only reconstructed selectors, canonical media, allowedproperty names and normalized literals/functions. No raw sourcelines. Apply atomically with stylesheet.textContent, never innerHTML; reject whole input on any error, retain last valid preview.
